description: Starter sample of labelled evidence packets for Phase 1 validation and as the seed for the golden set (Phase 3/4 expansion target: 20-30 per classifier/extractor).

evidence_packets.quote: I loved the dress but wasn't sure about the size, so I saved it and kept looking.

three_level.said: I loved the dress but wasn't sure about the size, so I saved it and kept looking.
three_level.inferred: User shortlists the dress and continues browsing.
three_level.concluded: Size confidence may delay wishlist-to-purchase conversion.

evidence_packets.quote: Wishlist is useless, I just add things and forget about them.
unmet_needs: reminders or relevance signals for saved items

three_level.said: Wishlist is useless, I just add things and forget about them.
three_level.inferred: User uses wishlist as a bookmark and does not revisit items.
three_level.concluded: Forgetting may explain non-purchase, but needs corroboration.

evidence_packets.quote: Keep saving sarees for my sister's wedding but I keep checking reviews to be sure the colour matches.

three_level.said: Keep saving sarees for my sister's wedding but I keep checking reviews to be sure the colour matches.
three_level.inferred: Occasion-driven shopper saves options and validates colour/quality via reviews.
three_level.concluded: Review and colour-representation confidence may gate occasion purchases.
